title: Roast chicken, cucumber and new potato salad

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Whole chicken, potatoes, yoghurt, salad vegetables and herbs are all plain home ingredients with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every item, including the whole chicken and little gems, is an everyday Tesco purchase.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray, bowls and a platter, and roasting a chicken is within a confident beginner's reach.

works.reason: A 1.5kg chicken roasted for 80 minutes at 200°C with halved new potatoes for 50 minutes will cook through, and the quantities suit four.

honest_times.reason: 25 minutes covers the halving, slicing, chopping and pulling the chicken, and 30 + 50 + 10 resting matches the 90-minute cook time.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, little gem is honestly lettuce, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: The dish is really a roast chicken and potato dinner, and the single sliced cucumber is just one of several salad bits rather than the point of the page meant to celebrate cucumber.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, plain British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Roast chicken, new potatoes and plenty of salad vegetables with a yoghurt dressing make a proper, appealing family dinner.
